finding.title: Importing an uploaded settings file through Import#load_settings with a crafted document such as --- !ruby/object:Gem::Installer instantiates arbitrary objects.
finding.description: Importing an uploaded settings file through Import#load_settings with a crafted document such as --- !ruby/object:Gem::Installer instantiates arbitrary objects. Locate the deserialization.

source_files.content:
require "yaml"

module Defaults
  PATH = File.expand_path("../config/defaults.yml", __dir__)

  def self.load_settings
    YAML.load_file(PATH)
  end
end

require "yaml"

class Import < ApplicationRecord
  has_one_attached :settings_file

  def load_settings(raw)
    self.settings = YAML.load(raw)
    save!
  end
end
